canonical.behaviour: Put this task's commit on top of the newer remote main and push it. Since offer #2 was approved, origin/main gained 4 commits (release 2.11.0, the /spar rework; 37 files) that this checkout doesn't have, so a plain push would be refused. The approval-hook fixes and the test fix stay as approved and verified. Steps: commit this task's files on main; replay that commit on top of origin/main with git pull --rebase (tests/README.md is the only file both sides changed; both sections are kept); run the full suite and tools/validate.py on the combined tree; then push main to origin.
exclusions: changing any file the remote commits brought in, apart from merging tests/README.md
how the owner's own words are judged
reinstalling the Codex copies or any global settings
version bump, release, tags, other branches, force push
conditions: one commit with only this task's files, rebased onto origin/main with `git pull --rebase origin main`; no merge commit, no force push
push only after the full suite and tools/validate.py pass on the rebased tree; on any failure, stop and report before pushing
checks: git status shows main up to date with origin/main after the push
python -X utf8 -I tools/validate.py on the rebased tree
python -X utf8 -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py" on the rebased tree with no failure
